wins: Consistent reward accumulation (70.0) indicating stable execution of scouting actions.
Mentor calls were leveraged (10 total) ensuring guidance-driven decisions during the run.
fails: Did not achieve success condition (0% success rate) due to repeated inability to progress beyond initial foothold.
Final reward plateaued without evidence of high-value action such as lateral movement or privilege escalation.
key_outcomes.summary: Scouting-phase actions were steady, but the agent failed to leverage the reconnaissance to achieve mission objectives, leaving the kill chain incomplete.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to transition from discovery to exploitation; attack stopped after port scanning without follow-up action.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port identified during scan (e.g., port 22 open)
skill_cards.then_action: Execute SSH enumeration using nmap ssh scripts to capture banner and supported ciphers.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service detected during reconnaissance
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto/gobuster to map directories and capture application version.

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance completes with high-value open service list
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize exploitation payload development for top service (e.g., SSH/HTTP) and validate with targeted modules.

parameters_template.decision_matrix: Rank services by exploitability and align tools like Metasploit, Hydra, or custom scripts.
